EFL Action Heats Up Across the Divisions

Recent EFL fixtures have brought notable developments across the Championship, League One, and League Two. Former striker and pundit Aaron McLean shared his observations on the weekend's action, highlighting standout performers and ongoing challenges for several clubs.

Key Takeaways from the Weekend

  • Middlesbrough's Ascent: Middlesbrough sit two points clear at the top of the Championship following a 3-0 victory over Charlton Athletic. Forward Will Lankshear continued his prolific home form, bringing his tally to 13 goals in 13 league appearances since his summer transfer.
  • West Ham's Home Struggles: West Ham United's difficulties at the London Stadium persisted with a 3-0 defeat against West Bromwich Albion. All three of the club's league defeats this season have occurred in front of their home supporters, leaving them positioned in eighth place.
  • Southampton's Momentum: Southampton moved up to fifth place in the Championship following a 4-1 win over QPR, overcoming an early-season points deduction. McLean noted that the team is benefiting from a unified squad mentality and strong individual performances.
  • Luton Town's Consistency Test: Luton Town secured their fourth consecutive League One victory with a 2-0 win away at Peterborough United, lifting them to fourth in the table ahead of a fixture against league leaders Huddersfield Town.
  • Fleetwood Town Rebounds: Following a Carabao Cup penalty shootout win against Arsenal, Fleetwood Town returned to League Two action with a 3-1 victory over Bristol Rovers to address their prior league form.
